_comment: check-self-use.mjs's allowlist. Every entry is a public export with zero call sites in src/lib outside its own declaring module and zero showcase call sites, argued legitimate rather than removed. Seeded from each export's ledger KEEP row where one exists (cited by slug); an export with no ledger row (introduced after the any-site audit, or the audit named a sibling under a since-renamed identifier) carries fresh prose instead, marked no-ledger-row. See docs/internal/engine-rulings.md for the audit-self-use ledger row this allowlist discharges.

entries.name: AdminActionAudit
entries.reason: keep: every adminAction-wrapped handler writes ctx.audit({ action, entity, entityId }); a site factoring its own audit helper names the type.

entries.name: AdminActionOptions
entries.reason: retire, open, not executed: routed to the F-1 leak-sanction ledger (f1-return-position-leak-sanction) as the sole argument-position closure leak, blocked on adminAction's own declared signature naming it. This gate does not force that retirement; it records the already-ledgered gap.

entries.name: AdminTableDensity
entries.reason: keep: names AdminTable's density prop for a consumer holding density in its own state, deliberately aligned with StatusChipSize's vocabulary.

entries.name: App.Locals
entries.reason: keep: the engine writes four keys onto event.locals that a site's routes read; the alternative is a hand-written declare global block tracking engine-owned fields by hand.

entries.name: AuthChannel
entries.reason: reshape (kept, reshaped signature): a site holding the constructed channel in a module-scope const and typing it.

entries.name: AuthChannelConfig
entries.reason: reshape (kept): the surface a consumer actually reads and writes; nobody calls createAuthChannel without building this object, though the showcase's own call site infers it structurally rather than annotating it, so this auth-path export clears only through the allowlist.

entries.name: AuthGuardOptions
entries.reason: keep: any site declaring roles or an access map writes this object in hooks.server.ts; each member is a decision only the site can make.

entries.name: AuthRoutes
entries.reason: keep: an annotation aid for a site hand-mounting auth, which holds the object TypeScript infers; the export is not a name the site must write, so no call site is expected.

entries.name: BooleanField
entries.reason: keep: the normalization rule (an absent or non-true value normalizes to unset) a site reading raw frontmatter must not read as a stored false.

entries.name: CairnAdminConfig
entries.reason: keep, renamed from CairnAdminOptions (conventions pass, Task 2): any site overriding a seam on the recommended mount (a custom mailer, a role filter over the sidebar, attention badges, a preview lifetime).

entries.name: CairnAdminRoutes
entries.reason: keep: cairn-admin.ts's own createCairnAdmin return is already ReturnType<typeof createCairnAdmin>, the single idiom the export exists to name; a site annotating the admin export in cairn.server.ts uses it.

entries.name: CairnManifestOptions
entries.reason: keep: a consumer factoring build config (a shared makeCairnPlugins, or a monorepo with two cairn sites) must name the parameter; the type is already reachable via Parameters<>, so naming it is strictly better.

entries.name: ChannelConfirmResult
entries.reason: reshape (kept, reshaped signature): a site rendering seven distinct confirm outcomes on its login form, each needing site copy. Entailed by createAuthChannel.

entries.name: ChannelRequestResult
entries.reason: reshape (kept, reshaped signature): a site's form action switching on the request result to pick a message. Entailed by createAuthChannel.

entries.name: ComposeInput
entries.reason: keep: a site with more than one composed runtime (a multi-tenant or preview build) factors the input into a builder and annotates its return.

entries.name: ContentProblem
entries.reason: keep: a content-health page holding index.problems(); nearly dead in practice (createSiteResolver throws on every non-draft problem first), but the reachable draft-failure case still needs the type.

entries.name: ContentRoutes
entries.reason: reshape, closed: the narrow 25-member public return createContentRoutes declares (Pick over the wide internal shape); this type is why two dozen janitorial types were public at all, and a site hand-mounting content routes without createCairnAdmin annotates it.

entries.name: CookieSetOptions
entries.reason: keep: a site writing a CairnEvent test double types the set signature; otherwise it is reached through CookieJar.

entries.name: DateField
entries.reason: keep: a dated concept's permalink requires a date field of this type, which defineConcept normalizes to required: true; a concept generator names the arm.

entries.name: DeliverContext
entries.reason: reshape (kept, membership grew with the createAuthChannel reopen): a site typing its own deliver implementation. Called from the showcase's capture-transport (examples/showcase/src/members/capture-transport.ts), but auth-channel is an auth path, so the showcase call site does not discharge this entry on its own.

entries.name: DatetimeField
entries.reason: keep: carries a live gap a site must know (accepted as a plain string today; the descriptor's min/max are not yet enforced by the validator).

entries.name: DeleteEditorOutcome
entries.reason: introduced by the auth-family reshape (conventions pass, Task 4, discriminated-result convention) after the any-site audit; same anonymous-consumer argument as the sibling OwnerGuardOutcome below: a site calling deleteEditor cannot declare the result without the type.

entries.name: EditorRoutes
entries.reason: keep: an annotation aid for a site hand-mounting editor routes, same thin case as AuthRoutes above (the export is ReturnType<typeof createEditorRoutes>, not a name the site must write).

entries.name: EditorRoutesConfig
entries.reason: keep, renamed from EditorRoutesOptions (conventions pass, Task 2): a site with a declared role vocabulary that hand-mounts the roster screen passes its defineRoles output here.

entries.name: EditorRow
entries.reason: keep: a site rendering its own roster screen writes const rows: EditorRow[] = await listEditors(db); without the type a consumer cannot declare a kept function's result.

entries.name: EmailField
entries.reason: keep: a shared field helper across a family of sites, typed at the module boundary.

entries.name: EmptyStateHeadingLevel
entries.reason: keep: a consumer whose empty state is a page's only content passes 'h1' so the page has a real heading in its accessible tree.

entries.name: EngineScreenId
entries.reason: keep: a site declaring navLayout writes { screen: 'media' }; the alias documents the fixed screen vocabulary while its (string & {}) tail keeps concept ids assignable.

entries.name: EntryDataOverrides
entries.reason: keep: a site rendering an entry through its own lookup with substituted resolvers (a staging preview, a per-branch render); the engine's own previewLoad is the only realized instance today.

entries.name: FieldBehavior
entries.reason: keep: BehaviorTable's element, encoding function-valued behavior a field descriptor cannot carry as plain data, invisible without the type.

entries.name: FieldLabel
entries.reason: keep: it carries a measured width hook the engine had to scope by hand (a direct child fills, a nested one does not) and the wrapping-label a11y trap where only the first labelable descendant gets a name.

entries.name: FieldsetOptions
entries.reason: keep: fieldset's options parameter, carrying refine; a site writing a shared refine-builder types the options object.

entries.name: FormatCivilDateOptions
entries.reason: keep: CairnMediaLibrary's own intlOptions passthrough proves the shape is not speculative; a consumer wanting a longer or shorter date shape needs it.

entries.name: FormatTimestampOptions
entries.reason: keep: the timeZone option is the load-bearing half of the hydration mechanic, letting a site state its own zone instead of inheriting one consumer's.

entries.name: GithubAppProvider
entries.reason: keep: a site reading cairn.backend.owner/.repo to build a view-on-GitHub link or deploy badge.

entries.name: HealthData
entries.reason: keep: an operator wiring /admin/healthz into an uptime check needs the payload shape to assert on.

entries.name: IconField
entries.reason: keep: the weakest arm of the field-descriptor family (declares no constraint beyond the type tag), kept for the family's own evenness.

entries.name: ImageField
entries.reason: keep: carries the seo marker designating the social-card image, a site-wide singleton concern.

entries.name: ListToolbarFilterOption
entries.reason: keep: names one option in a filter's vocabulary including its count, carrying the 'All 6' copy rule in the component rather than leaving it to each site.

entries.name: MagicLinkMessage
entries.reason: keep: the entire contract between engine and site on the custom-sender seam, since buildMagicLinkMessage was demoted; a consumer supplying a custom SendMagicLink receives an already-built MagicLinkMessage rather than building one.

entries.name: NavLayoutEngineRef
entries.reason: keep: placing or hiding an engine screen (media, settings, editors) in a site's own sidebar order has no other seam, since the screens are engine routes and the sidebar is engine markup.

entries.name: NavLayoutEntry
entries.reason: keep: every site adding one custom admin screen writes a NavLayoutEntry to put a door on it; its icon field is a closed 27-value union of engine-shipped glyph names a site cannot infer without the type.

entries.name: NavLayoutSection
entries.reason: keep: a site grouping its own admin screens under a heading declares a section; the admin sidebar is engine-rendered chrome a site cannot patch any other way.

entries.name: NavMenuConfig
entries.reason: keep: declaring editor.nav is what turns /admin/nav from a 404 into a working screen, an engine route a site cannot otherwise reach; configPath and menuName bind it to the YAML the site also reads with extractMenu.

entries.name: NavRoutes
entries.reason: keep: an annotation aid for a site hand-mounting nav routes, same thin case as AuthRoutes above (the export is ReturnType<typeof createNavRoutes>).

entries.name: OwnerGuardOutcome
entries.reason: the anti-lockout primitives (removeOwnerIfNotLast, demoteOwnerIfNotLast, and their shared result type OwnerGuardOutcome) for sites managing rosters outside ManageEditors; the engine's own routes deliberately use the wider deleteEditor/setEditorRole helpers instead, so zero engine call sites is the intended shape, not a defect.

entries.name: PublicRoutes
entries.reason: reshape, reopened 2026-08-30: the required authored return type of createPublicRoutes under convention-contract-first-returns, which bans the ReturnType<typeof f> idiom for every public factory; the type exists to satisfy that engine-wide contract, not a measured consumer call site.

entries.name: RateLimitOutcome
entries.reason: the four-arm discriminated result resolveRateLimit returns (closed reshape, conventions pass Task 4); a site factoring a shared rate-limit helper cannot declare the result without the type, same reasoning as EditorRow above.

entries.name: Renderer
entries.reason: keep: a site composing its renderer once and passing it around, the exact shape three family chassis modules already carry in src/chassis/render.ts.

entries.name: RendererOptions
entries.reason: keep: the archetype of an absorbed divergence; before the plugin seam a site re-parsed cairn's HTML into a second unified pipeline, after it the site's plugin composes over the same hast tree, and that plugin annotates this options shape.

entries.name: ReproHeights
entries.reason: keep: any site sizing an embed iframe before load makes the indexed read entry.heights[width] ?? entry.heights.column, exactly as cairn-pub's own repro-marker.ts does.

entries.name: RequestResult
entries.reason: keep: a site rendering its own login form branches on form.status to show check-your-email, try-again, or wait-a-moment.

entries.name: ResolveOptions
entries.reason: keep: a site threading its resolvers through a wrapper, function renderEntry(md, opts: ResolveOptions), names it; every family site builds such a wrapper in theme/render.ts, none yet needing the annotation.

entries.name: RoleDeclaration
entries.reason: keep: a site building its vocabulary programmatically, mapping a permissions table onto roles, annotates each value and gets the two-arm union checked.

entries.name: SectionAction
entries.reason: the return type of createSectionAction (docs/reference/sveltekit.md), the per-call-site wrapper a site factoring a custom section action out of its own actions record would annotate; introduced with the security-critical createSectionAction seam, so it is auth-path allowlist-only rather than a showcase-remedy candidate.

entries.name: SectionActionAudit
entries.reason: keep: a handler touching two entities in one call overrides entity on the second emit and needs this defaulting shape.

entries.name: SectionActionConfig
entries.reason: keep: every site using the seam writes this object once per section and must name it to annotate Env, since Env does not infer from resolveDb alone; a security-critical export, so it is auth-path allowlist-only rather than a showcase-remedy candidate.

entries.name: SectionActionContext
entries.reason: keep: a site factoring a wrapped handler out of its actions record annotates ctx: SectionActionContext<D1Database>.

entries.name: SectionActionOptions
entries.reason: keep: every wrapped call site writes { action, entity }, and a parameterized or catch-all route must declare target since the pathname there is attacker-chosen.

entries.name: SeoFields
entries.reason: keep: annotating a helper that carries SEO fields after readSeoFields; the four keys are the engine's declared SEO vocabulary.

entries.name: SeoInput
entries.reason: keep: a chassis helper assembling head inputs for several bespoke page types before calling buildSeoMeta; twelve call sites build it inline today because it never crosses a module boundary.

entries.name: SetEditorRoleOutcome
entries.reason: introduced by the auth-family reshape (conventions pass, Task 4, discriminated-result convention) after the any-site audit; same anonymous-consumer argument as OwnerGuardOutcome: a site calling setEditorRole cannot declare the result without the type.

entries.name: SiteIndexes
entries.reason: keep: annotating the chassis/content.ts export every family site keeps, or passing the whole bundle into a helper; carries the reserved 'site' key rule createSiteIndexes throws on.

entries.name: StatusChipRegister
entries.reason: keep: the two registers carry canvas-measured contrast across four grounds a consumer cannot re-derive without its own probe rig.

entries.name: StatusChipSize
entries.reason: keep: the sm/xs distinction is measured, not cosmetic (sm reserves a 5rem minimum width, xs carries none).

entries.name: TextField
entries.reason: keep: the arm a multi-site developer factors out first, since a title field appears in every concept, and its sharpest failure mode (a malformed pattern throws at the fieldset() call) matters to a consumer building fields programmatically.

entries.name: TidyEffort
entries.reason: TidyClient.tidy's optional effort field (docs/reference/sveltekit.md), the adaptive-thinking tier vocabulary for a model with effort tiers; a site wiring its own TidyClient implementation against the documented contract needs the type, an Unstable API introduced after the any-site audit.

entries.name: ToolbarDisclosureAriaHaspopup
entries.reason: ToolbarDisclosure's ariaHaspopup prop vocabulary (docs/reference/admin-toolkit.md), forwarded onto the trigger's own aria-haspopup; a consumer composing a custom trigger/panel pair around the primitive needs the type, introduced after the any-site audit.

entries.name: ToolbarDisclosurePanelAttrs
entries.reason: the attrs ToolbarDisclosure's panel snippet receives (docs/reference/admin-toolkit.md); a consumer writing its own panel snippet spreads these onto its root element and needs the type, introduced after the any-site audit.

entries.name: ToolbarDisclosureTriggerAttrs
entries.reason: the attrs ToolbarDisclosure's trigger snippet receives (docs/reference/admin-toolkit.md); a consumer writing its own trigger snippet spreads these last onto its element and needs the type, introduced after the any-site audit.

entries.name: UnauditedActionError
entries.reason: keep: a site whose handleError or test harness must distinguish this dev-only authoring signal from a real failure asserts on the class rather than a message string.

entries.name: UrlField
entries.reason: keep: same shared-helper scenario as EmailField, marginally stronger because URL fields most often get wrapped with site conventions (required protocol, allowed hosts).

entries.name: ValidateReproFenceOptions
entries.reason: the caller-owned half of validateReproFence's options (docs/reference/reproductions.md); a site registering its own MDsveX components against the showcase's reproduction-fence convention needs the type, introduced after the any-site audit.

entries.name: VerifyTurnstileOptions
entries.reason: keep: a site factoring its Turnstile guard into a shared helper must annotate that helper's options argument.

entries.name: buildSitemapView
entries.reason: keep, renamed from sitemapView (conventions pass, Task 3): a sitemap must list exactly the routable concepts, membership that comes from engine-owned routing flags a site cannot re-derive.

entries.name: createD1AuditSink
entries.reason: keep: any Workers site wanting admin mutations persisted rather than only logged, since Workers Logs expire.

entries.name: createSectionAction
entries.reason: keep: any site adding one custom admin screen with a form, since SvelteKit dispatches a matched action directly and never re-runs an ancestor load, so an unwrapped action would look gated while the POST is not; a security-critical export, so it is auth-path allowlist-only rather than a showcase-remedy candidate.

entries.name: defineAccess
entries.reason: keep: construction-time validation of a declaration that would otherwise fail in production as a wrong grant, including the rule that stops an empty list reading as everyone (owner-only must be written ['owner']); a security-critical export, so it is auth-path allowlist-only rather than a showcase-remedy candidate.

entries.name: demoteOwnerIfNotLast
entries.reason: the anti-lockout primitive for sites managing rosters outside ManageEditors; the engine's own routes deliberately use the wider setEditorRole helper instead, so zero engine call sites is the intended shape. See OwnerGuardOutcome above.

entries.name: diffNewlyPublished
entries.reason: keep, renamed from newlyPublishedEntries (conventions pass, Task 3): announcing a post on first publish is not derivable by a consumer, since it depends on the publishedAt stamp and upsertEntry's carry-forward rules.

entries.name: fixtureMediaFiles
entries.reason: keep: a site serving the fixture bytes needs the content-hashed names for prerender entries() and as the allowlist keeping a [...file] route from walking the installed package tree.

entries.name: getStory
entries.reason: keep: a /repro/[id] route resolves a URL param to the one story it mounts and throws on an unknown id rather than rendering a blank frame.

entries.name: removeOwnerIfNotLast
entries.reason: the anti-lockout primitive for sites managing rosters outside ManageEditors; the engine's own routes deliberately use the wider deleteEditor helper instead, so zero engine call sites is the intended shape. See OwnerGuardOutcome above.

entries.name: requireAccess
entries.reason: keep: a site with more than two kinds of admin user gates its own route in one line against the map it already declared, and gets the denial log for free; a security-critical export, so it is auth-path allowlist-only rather than a showcase-remedy candidate.

entries.name: validateReproFence
entries.reason: reshape (kept, engine half): the story-resolution and declared-width half is engine-only; a site's own reproduction-fence directive calls it to validate against the resolved manifest.

entries.name: verifyTurnstile
entries.reason: keep: any Workers site with a public Turnstile form; the naive siteverify fetch trusts a malformed 200 body and throws on a fetch failure, a bot bypass two family sites shipped to production before this export existed.
